Our program blends the power of AWS training DevOps skills with real-world projects, giving you practical exposure to cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, containerization, and configuration management tools. The AWS DevOps course covers everything from foundational cloud concepts to advanced DevOps practices, ensuring you’re industry-ready. Our approach to DevOps AWS training is highly practical, emphasizing hands-on labs, live assignments, and continuous integration workflows to match today’s IT industry standards. If you’re located in Pune, our dedicated AWS DevOps classes in Pune offer instructor-led training with flexible batches, perfect for students and working professionals. Whether you are transitioning into a DevOps role or aiming to specialize in AWS Cloud, this course prepares you for globally recognized certifications and high-demand job roles. With 3RI Technologies’ placement support and real-time project experience, you’ll be ready to step into the cloud and DevOps industry with confidence. Join our AWS & DevOps course today to gain the skills and certifications employers are actively seeking—and take your IT career to the next level. Course Features Key Features Learn how to create architecture that is highly optimized, accessible, robust, and fully managed. Learn how AWS and DevOps may help you achieve cost optimization. Learn about measures for creating robust architecture. Study data security, backup, and disaster recovery procedures. Explore out more about DevOps and AWS deployment. Exposure to real-world industrial expertise through project workshops and online training. Training from experts with extensive industry expertise. Access to recorded classes. Support for Placement Job placement Support include résumé preparation, conducting mock interviews, and providing one-on-one counselling. Skills Required / Requirements /Pre-requisites There are no prerequisites for this DevOps and AWS Package Course because the candidate will be trained by a certified trainer. Participants must have graduated from a college or university with a degree such as B.Tech CSE/IT, B.SC. IT/Computers. DevOps and AWS Package Course incorporates the most recent organizational approaches as well. Besides, DevOps and AWS Package provides you with Professional level certification exam principles in the DevOps industry through its AWS Certified DevOps Engineer certification. Specific prerequisites must be met, including the following: At least one programming language proficiency. having a strong background in creating technically advanced infrastructure You must be well-versed in OS administration. A thorough understanding of core business, development, and a variety of methodologies Enrol in a DevOps and AWS Package whether you are a novice or an expert to advance your skills and pass the professional level AWS DevOps certification exam. Who can apply for the course? / Who should attend this Training? Anyone interested in improving their talents, whether they are a beginner or an expert, can apply for the course. Technology and cloud computing are among the topics covered in the package’s beginner to advanced courses, which are taught by professionals with real-world experience who are also AWS and DevOps certified. The primary objective of the DevOps and AWS Package Course is to introduce Engineers and Developers to the fundamental concepts of DevOps so they may pursue careers as DevOps engineers. The applicant for the job will be able to rise to the positions of Senior DevOps Engineer and AWS Lead with the help of this DevOps and AWS Course Training. Overview of DevOps and AWS Training at 3RI Technologies 3RI Technologies, a platform for advanced technology training, professionals and recent graduates can obtain the advanced training they need to meet market requirements.3RI Technologies-offers in-person training courses include DevOps and AWS courses that are tailored to the needs of the business and are instructed by top-notch educators with more than 7+ years of technical expertise. Our subject-matter specialists created the exercises, case studies, and assignments in the training programme, and they are relevant to the present. DevOps and AWS training course is one of the renowned courses and certifications provided by 3RI Technologies may be helpful if you are unfamiliar with DevOps and AWS and don’t know where to begin. Regardless of your level of experience, a DevOps and AWS training course may help you grasp and explain the advantages of these two technologies. Job Aspirants in this DevOps and AWS Course receive support from the trainer expert as they put the principles into practise and develop their technical expertise. Market of DevOps and AWS Package Course DevOps and AWS are in great demand now and in the coming years Enrolling in a DevOps and AWS course might help you learn the abilities needed to work in the cloud. You will acquire the skills and knowledge necessary to manage and safeguard your infrastructure. Whether you are a business executive or an IT professional, our DevOps AWS training course will meet your needs regardless of where you are on the DevOps and AWS learning curve. DevOps and AWS Package Course will help you demonstrate to executive leadership that you are capable of working in a DevOps and AWS environment, even if you are unfamiliar with the specific DevOps and AWS-related technologies your company uses. If your firm uses a specialised set of DevOps and AWS technologies that are created especially for that platform or product, you might want to take a look at a DevOps and AWS Package Course. Job opportunities for DevOps and AWS Certified candidates Due to the increasing usage of cloud services by organisations throughout the world, IT professionals who opt to pursue AWS and DevOps certifications may expect earning highest salaries. As demand in these technologies grows, there will be a greater need for certifications that attest to AWS and DevOps expertise, which will encourage IT professionals to pursue these high paying certifications. Your next goal could be to apply your skills to earn an increasingly respected AWS and DevOps certification. To become prepared for the industry, enrol in the DevOps and AWS Package Certification Course. Why learn AWS and DevOps Package? The concepts you will learn and master are design and deployment, application performance management, continuous delivery, continuous integration, load balancing, data flow on AWS, building AWS architecture.. In this DevOps and AWS Package Course, you will learn about cutting-edge tools and technologies that streamline organisational operations. By functioning together, IT software developers and software operators want to achieve automated, repeatable software development and deployment. 2. What are the objectives of AWS and DevOps certification training? The objectives of AWS and DevOps certification training course is designed to help people who want to learn AWS and need a deep understanding of the subject in order to implement things in the cloud that can help their business. This AWS tutorial gives you the skills to set up a virtual server, set up an RDMS, and monitor a resource deployed in the AWS cloud. 3. Who should you go for this AWS and DevOps training? The AWS and DevOps Training course would be most helpful for the following professional occupations. Solution Architects Programmers Cloud Developers Cloud Software Engineers AWS Engineer Experts DevOps Professionals Any recent grad or potential employee seeking for careers in the cloud Any professional interested in running highly scalable, fault-tolerant applications on the AWS platform must take this AWS course. 4. What will be covered in this DevOps and AWS Training? The design, implementation, and maintenance of applications on Amazon Web Services are covered in this DevOps and AWS Course certification, along with the most popular DevOps methodologies. Beginners who wish to learn about fundamental AWS services, important AWS security ideas, methods for migrating from on-premises to AWS, and the fundamentals of developing server-less apps with AWS are advised to take the DevOps with AWS Course. Candidates for certification exams have to have some prior experience building and deploying apps in the AWS Cloud. DevOps and AWS Training Course on DevOps with AWS for candidates who want to deepen and confirm their broad grasp of AWS and DevOps Services. 5. What is the duration of DevOps and AWS Package Course? The three to four month long course may be finished at your own pace and is customizable, available from anywhere. In live online sessions facilitated by industry experts, candidates receive training on ongoing industry projects with a surprisingly high level of engagement. 6. What if I come across a doubt after completing my course? Our trainer experts specializes in assisting candidates, therefore if any candidate has queries following the completion of their course, all inquiries will be answered by our trainer specialists, as well as help the applicant with any real-world job projects. 7. What is the placement assistance provided by 3RI Technologies? Job seekers will get placement assistance in major MNCs after completing the DevOps and AWS Package course and getting trained from our best experienced industry experts.
